event: US Michigan consumer sentiment (final, Nov) Fri 20 Nov 17:00 SAST (time per Kitco, UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: New yearly low
bullets.text: Gold broke under this morning's 3,693 low and touched 3,668.80, then traded near 3,686 at 18:38 SAST (Kitco).

bullets.title: Claims beat forecast
bullets.text: US jobless claims were 203,000 against 197,000 expected, and gold slipped toward its lows after the 15:30 SAST release.

bullets.title: Philly Fed weaker
bullets.text: The Philly Fed index fell to 6.3 from 20.9, a six-month low, but it did not lift gold for long.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields high
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 103.85, its highest since April 2025, and the US 10-year yield is near 5.07% (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Hike bets firm
bullets.text: Markets price about a 90% chance of a quarter-point Fed hike on 9 December, and Waller has raised the idea of a half point.

bullets.title: Hormuz headlines
bullets.text: Kitco reports renewed Strait of Hormuz tensions, which can bring sudden safe-haven spikes (details UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Oversold trend
bullets.text: The trend is down but stretched, so sharp short bounces are likely around the lows.
